Agent Name: Assistant
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Assistant failed to correctly apply the syntactic rules of the Tizin language. Specifically, it ignored the instruction that the verb "Maktay" is better translated as "is pleasing to," which implies the object of the liking (apples) should be the subject of the sentence, and the person doing the liking (I) should be the object. Consequently, the Assistant constructed the sentence as "Maktay Zapple Mato" (Verb-Object-Subject), treating "Mato" (I) as the subject, rather than the correct structure "Maktay Pa Zapple" (Verb-Subject-Object) where "Pa" (I) is the object receiving the pleasure from "Zapple" (Apples).
